name: tour_average_driver
qualification: kinematic fit settings for the tour-average driver capture; not physical or scientific acceptance

provenance.stature_m: owner decision: PGA Tour average male, best estimate about 1.82 m; not measured
provenance.mass_kg: kept from the previous driver candidate; not re-estimated in the kinematic study
provenance.trunk_scale: mid-hip to neck joint 623 mm: the fitted 665 mm less the 42 mm the thigh gains; the capture fixes their sum, not the split (leg study on #15296)
provenance.arm_scale: upper arm 297 mm and forearm 283 mm joint to joint, the typical 1.82 m body of the second fit study
provenance.shoulder_scale: shoulder joint half-spacing 180 mm; fits with it free gave 178-183 mm
provenance.shoulder_below_cervicale_m: chosen inside the fitted 85-110 mm range; medium-low confidence
provenance.thigh_length_m: prior, not measured: hip to knee joint centre of a 1.82 m male (de Leva 441 mm), both legs; the capture does not identify it (misfit flat from 399 to 441 mm)
provenance.shank_length_m: mean of the two stored OpenSim shanks, both legs; lateral knee to ankle marker distance in the capture is 422-425 mm, and a 453 mm shank fits worse
provenance.hip_half_spacing_m: the builder value, 0.052 of stature; fits at 85, 94.6 and 105 mm do not separate it
provenance.club: owner decision: standard driver with typical component masses (club_models.DRIVER)
provenance.club_butt_to_sole_m: owner decision: 45 in measured butt to sole along the shaft; not measured on the captured club
provenance.club_shaft_elevation_deg: shaft axis elevation at address in the club-only registration of the driver capture
provenance.club_head_roll_deg: ground normal about the shaft at address in the club-only registration; follows its roll setting, which the club markers cannot identify
provenance.club_markers: club-only registration evidence/club_markers/driver_club_only.json; head-frame offsets do not depend on club length
